pstack-verifier: PASS+NOTES @ 3ded88fdb6494f87f980285d8771165b1b5bdc66

Verified by DeepSeek (deepseek-flash), a different model family from the author, on a GitHub-hosted runner. It read the diff and text evidence only, never screenshots.

The diff adds a coherent Switch AI path (menu row, target sub-page, switch_ai request, switched/unknown/failed handling with reattach and toast) and the head build plus smoke journey show no regression, but no journey exercised the new switch flow. The feature's promised outcomes are therefore shown only by unrun unit tests and by reading the diff.

Journeys driven (parent is the app before this change, head is after):
- `native-skills.md` parent: passed, head: passed

Pipeline notes:
- Only the smoke journey was driven, so the app still works but this change itself was not exercised. No catalog journey drives the new desktop-hosted reader Switch AI menu or verifies the provider reattach.

Evidence:
- native-skills.md passed on head (job success) with the reader model and effort menus captured (11-native-model-menu.xml, 12-native-effort-menu.xml), so the reader menu still works after adding the SWITCH_AI page.
- native-skills.md passed identically on parent, so the same-result comparison shows no regression but proves nothing about the switch feature.
- SwitchAi.kt adds query() with the desktop keys (op/id/provider/sid/to), targets() excluding the current provider, and outcome() parsing switched/busy/other plus envelope id and message_protocol checks.
- SwitchAiTest.kt covers request shape, offered targets, busy/refused/missing replies, but the description states these tests were not run and nothing was verified on a device.
- SshRepository.switchAi streams the query with a 60s inner timeout under SessionReaderConnection's 75s SWITCH_TIMEOUT_MS, and TimeoutCancellationException maps to Outcome.Unknown rather than a crash.
- MainViewModel.switchAi/followSwitch update the session list in place, reattach the open reader when the chat is still open, and otherwise close the warm reader so the next open uses the new provider.
- MultipromptApp.kt only shows the Switch AI row when SwitchAi.supported(hostedProvider(session.agent, session.hostSessionId), hostSessionId) is true; the smoke fixture is a local Claude Code reader, so that row was almost certainly never displayed.

Not covered:
- The Switch AI menu row appearing for a desktop-hosted chat and the sub-page listing only the other two AIs.
- The switch_ai request actually being sent and the server replying switched, with the open chat reattaching as the new AI and the list keeping the same name and place.
- The 'Chat switched to Codex/Claude/Pi' toast being shown after a real switch.
- The busy reply leaving the chat in place with 'wait for this reply to finish' and other refusals showing 'this live chat cannot switch'.
- The unknown/timeout fallback that re-lists sessions and either follows the switch or reports 'no answer yet'.
- Whether readerSession is updated after reattach so a second switch offers the correct remaining AIs.

Run: https://github.com/valentinyeo/multiprompt-android/actions/runs/43710816750
